posts.text: I think my only gripe here is that it’s a business where cashflows are currently getting locked in working capital requirements. FCF is currently negative and any issues with trade partners and cost of inputs will cause this to decline. I understand the Capex is high right now and is probably a good thing but even on the Operating level cash flows seem slim. Scaling will be a challenge.
